projectDescription: A blazingly-fast OSINT CLI tool that hunts usernames across the internet by fusing the WhatsMyName, Sherlock, and Maigret databases with high-concurrency Go workers.
keyFeatures: Up to 3x faster than competing OSINT tools like Blackbird
250 concurrent goroutine workers for parallel site checking
Three integrated databases: WhatsMyName, Sherlock, and Maigret
Interactive TUI mode powered by Bubble Tea with real-time progress
Configurable HTTP timeout for speed vs. thoroughness tradeoffs
Cross-platform: pre-built binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows (amd64 & arm64)
UPX-compressed release binaries for minimal footprint
